request.style: English, female voice, solo with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, strings, gentle, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I will ask the Father now
He will give you another guide
To be with you forevermore
In the quiet of the night

[Pre-Chorus]
The Spirit of truth comes near
Who the world cannot receive
It neither sees nor knows his face
But you have him within

[Chorus]
Another Advocate with you
The Spirit of truth remains
He is in you and with you
The truth that no one claims

[Verse]
He will not leave you as orphans
I am coming to return
In a little while you see
The Father in the Son

[Pre-Chorus]
The world will see me no more
But you will see me live
Because I live you will live
In the Father and in me

[Chorus]
Another Advocate with you
The Spirit of truth remains
He is in you and with you
The truth that no one claims

[Bridge]
You know him for he stays
He remains with you always
The world does not know his name
But you are not alone

[Outro]
You know him for he stays
The Spirit of truth
He remains with you
